## Session Context (SDR-MCP)
You have RTL-SDR tools: device control, spectrum, stations, GNU Radio demod.
Before starting work:
1. sdr_device(operation="health")
2. sdr_device(operation="list")
3. sdr_spectrum(operation="spectrum")
At end of work: sdr_gnuradio(operation="stop") if the sidecar runs.
